# Lattice

Lattice is deterministic multi-agent benchmarking with auditable replay: a headless .NET 10 environment for seeded Dec-POMDP-style experiments where every run is a replayable recording. The committed 32-rollout MCTS study loses to a deterministic heuristic on standard maps and wins under capacity-1 bottleneck contention; both results ship with their confidence intervals and artifacts.
